newsitem.title: USA: May Department Q3 same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: May Department Q3 same store sales up.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Monday its same store sales for the third quarter rose 3.9 percent compared with a year ago.
For the year-to-date period, same store sales gained 4.2 percent.
Earlier, May reported earnings for the third quarter ended November 2 of $0.44 a share, up from earnings from continuing operations a year ago of $0.41 a share.
May said it opened five stores during the quarter -- two Lord & Taylor stores, one Foley's store, one Kaufmann's store and one Famous-Barr store.

Year-to-date, May has opened 24 stores, including 13 acquired locations, and plans to open an additional four stores in November. May operates 364 department stores in 30 states and the District of Columbia.
